## Scientific integrity
- [ ] No invented measurements, connections, test outcomes or causal claims
- [ ] Units, provenance, timestamps, missing values and data kinds preserved where applicable
- [ ] Source/API/license/auth constraints verified for any new integration

## Checks performed
- [ ] Python API tests passed
- [ ] TypeScript checks passed
- [ ] Shared API contract regenerated if changed
- [ ] Relevant responsive, loading, empty and failure states checked
- [ ] No secrets or large datasets committed

## Review
- [ ] At least one teammate reviewed before merge
- [ ] Shared working-tree coordination completed before syncing
